facts.name: The Peach Bucket

observations.status: public marketing assertions, not independently verified product safety evidence
observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

facts.constraints: Availability unknown: no scarcity. Policy eligibility details not supplied; do not expand policies. Adult supervision remains necessary. These are saved website observations, not a fresh website check.
facts.visual_brief: Same assumed creative for every condition: product-kit photograph on a plain cream background. No image is supplied to the model; do not claim to inspect a photograph.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent whose child is starting to explore cupboards. Help them consider the kit as part of preparing their home. This is a hypothetical audience scenario, not customer research. Do not imply any lock fits every cupboard or that the kit replaces supervision.

variants.concept: Cupboard-area preparation: introduce cabinet/fridge locks while making clear suitability depends on the cupboard.
variants.primary_text: Little hands are starting to explore the cupboards? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes cabinet/fridge locks to consider as part of cupboard-area prep. Check that the locks suit your cupboard doors before buying; the kit is one part of home preparation, not a replacement for adult supervision.
variants.headline: Cabinet locks for cupboard prep

variants.concept: Installation guidance: address uncertainty about setting up the kit with the included one-to-one video support.
variants.primary_text: Already picturing cupboard locks, but unsure about installation? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support, so you can refer to guidance while setting up the kit at home. It’s a practical extra as you prepare for a child who’s beginning to explore. Adult supervision remains necessary.
variants.headline: Installation video support for your kit

variants.concept: Multiple home touchpoints: position the kit as an option for considering more than cupboard doors.
variants.primary_text: With cupboards becoming part of your child’s exploring, you may also be thinking about other parts of the home. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit pairs cabinet/fridge locks with socket guards and edge/corner protectors, bringing several childproofing touchpoints into one kit. It’s a home-prep option, alongside—not instead of—adult supervision.
variants.headline: Childproofing touchpoints in one kit

output.internal_notes: The cupboard-exploration scenario is hypothetical. Specific cupboard compatibility and policy eligibility details were not supplied; the copy avoids implying universal fit and does not present the kit as a replacement for adult supervision.
